transcript: Took the day off and drove to Santa Cruz with Maya. Foggy in the morning but it cleared up around noon. We rented bikes, rode along the cliffs, saw like a hundred surfers. Got clam chowder in a bread bowl on the wharf and watched the sea lions yelling at each other. Sunburnt now.

spec.moment: Eating clam chowder in bread bowls on the wooden wharf while watching sea lions below.

elements.name: wooden wharf
elements.look: weathered gray-brown timber deck with heavy wooden railings

elements.name: bread bowls
elements.look: two round sourdough bread bowls steaming with creamy clam chowder on a picnic table

elements.name: sea lions
elements.look: two sleek brown sea lions lounging on wooden crossbeams beneath the pier deck

elements.name: rental bikes
elements.look: two colorful beach cruiser bikes leaning together against the wharf railing

elements.name: Maya and me
elements.look: two figures in bright windbreakers and sun-reddened cheeks leaning over the rail

spec.scene: A weathered wooden wharf deck bathed in bright coastal afternoon sun. At the center, two round sourdough bread bowls of clam chowder sit on a rustic picnic bench. Leaning over the sturdy wooden railing are two figures in windbreakers, peering down at two plump brown sea lions perched on timber beams below. On the left, two colorful cruiser bikes rest against the rail. The sun casts sharp, warm shadows across the splintered gray planks.
spec.title: Chowder on the Wharf
spec.caption: Ate hot chowder on the pier while the sea lions yelled.
